name: Sudo Robotics
summary:
Sudo Robotics develops integrated robots and AI for physical manipulation. Its sudo R1 system combines internally developed hardware and software with a manipulation-focused foundation model. Object picking is the starting capability, reflecting the role of grasping in many larger tasks such as sorting, handling and assembly.

The company uses simulation-based training to build skills that can transfer to real-world objects and conditions. Its research emphasizes making physical execution reliable across varied situations, alongside the higher-level planning abilities of AI models. This approach targets the practical gap between understanding a requested task and successfully carrying out the first contact with an object.
